**Definition quote (Reproducibility section, verbatim):**

> Repeatability must be measured on unchanged records under the same evaluator model and definition, because even a fixed or zero sampling temperature does not guarantee identical semantic judgements.

The section is present and reads as the current instrument (sha256 `9d08b5f3…0e7dd3`), so I proceeded.

## Evaluation complete — `output_evaluation.json`

Validation run exactly as specified: `VALID output_evaluation.json: rubric20-semantic` (exit 0).

**Score: 80 / 88 — fixed 90.9% (denominator 88), normalized 90.9% (adjusted denominator 88).** No question was excluded, so the two bases coincide; `excluded_max_points` 0, `questions_not_applicable` 0, `excluded_item_ids` empty.

| Category | Score |
|---|---|
| Structural Completeness (Q1–5) | 17 / 21 |
| Metadata Quality & Content (Q6–10) | 20 / 21 |
| Technical Documentation (Q11–15) | 23 / 25 |
| FAIRness & Accessibility (Q16–20) | 20 / 21 |

**Applicability.** All four gated conditions were resolved on fields belonging to *other* questions, per the anti-circular rule, and each is recorded with `applicability_status` and `applicability_evidence`: human subjects (Q8, Q15) from `description`/`keywords`/`collection_mechanisms`; datasets shared (Q10, Q17) from `distribution_formats.access_urls`, the research-permitting licence and `third_party_sharing`; software output (Q11) from `external_resources` code repositories (b2aiprep, senselab) and `extension_mechanism.contribution_url`; collection-plus-shared (Q12, Q13) from `description` and `direct_collection`.

**Points deducted, with reasons.** Q3 (3) — four generic keywords; condition coverage exists but only as prose inside a collection description. Q4 (3) — exactly three formats/media types, the counting band's ceiling, despite outstanding per-file enumeration. Q10 (4) — `conforms_to_schema` names the datasheet's own LinkML schema, not a data-level standard, which the record honestly declines to assert. Q13 (4) — `latest_version_doi` (`10.13026/37yb-1t42`) matches no enumerated version and is the one uncaveated identifier inconsistency. Q15 and Q20 (4 each) — no demographic distributions, so the declared representation skew is unquantifiable and fairness analysis stays qualitative.

**Semantic analysis:** 9 issues (2 failed consistency checks — the unresolved latest-version DOI, and `hipaa_compliant: compliant` against the DTUA's own "not covered under HIPAA"; 6 warnings), 25 checks passed, 12 positive insights. Correctness validations: DOI `valid_physionet` (10.13026), grant `valid_nih` (OT2OD032720 parses as an OT2/OD award), RRID `valid` (SCR_007345), URLs `all_valid`.

Provenance values, `d4d_file`, the three hashes, `instrument_kind: agent_definition`, `temperature: null`, and the runtime model (`claude-opus-5[1m]`, as both `name` and `evaluator_model`) are recorded as instructed.
